correctness.rationale: Writing \(x=\cos(2\pi r/N)\) and \(T_3(x)=4x^3-3x\), the proposed polynomial factors through the two adjacent sampled values \(u\le-\sqrt3/2\le v\). The sign of the third factor is fixed on \([-1,1]\), so the factorization proves feasibility on every grid point. Off contact, a positive two-point combination at \(u,v\) cancels the \(T_3\) coefficient and gives the matching upper bound; when \(12\mid N\), the sampled contact point itself gives the sharp bound. This is an all-\(N\) proof rather than an inference from the bundled finite verifier.
correctness.risk: The statement is confined to the exact support \(\{0,\pm1,\pm3\}\) in the polynomial and to a uniform cyclic sampling grid.
